basic_profile.bio: Avid woodworker and scroll saw enthusiast from the Midwest, USA. I picked up scrolling as a hobby about six years ago, and it quickly turned into a passion. I enjoy cycling on weekends, and I'm an active member of the local cycling club. I work as a software developer during the day, which gives me the flexibility to spend evenings and weekends in my garage workshop. Married for 10 years with two kids, I often scroll in the evenings after the kids are asleep. I’m usually online during late evenings and nights, sharing tips and tricks or helping newcomers to the craft.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Extensive knowledge in woodworking, especially scroll sawing, acquired through years of self-teaching and community engagement. I initially learned through online resources and YouTube tutorials, and now I contribute my expertise on forums and Reddit. I also have a solid foundation in software development, which helps with problem-solving and creative design in woodworking.
